patch.value: GH-680: completed Plan close must transition plan_mode terminally

GitHub issue https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/680 reports that closing a fully completed Plan leaves plan_mode executing with no terminal transition command. Define and enforce terminal Plan state semantics across CLI, SDK, and history.
